body.p: In the non-final Office Action', the Examiner rejected claims 1-20 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Lo et al. (U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2016/0100036, hereinafter Lo) in view of Hu et al. (U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2022/0362666, hereinafter Hu).

By this Amendment, Applicant amends claims 1, 2, 6, and 19-20, cancels claims 3-4 and 10 without any prejudice and disclaimer of the subject matter thereof, and adds new claims 21- 23. Support for the amendments can be found throughout the as-filed application, for example, in para. [0120]-[0124] of the specification and FIG. 4 of the drawings. Upon entry of this Amendment, claims 1-2, 5-9, and 11-23 remain pending and under examination.
Applicant respectfully requests that the Office favorably reconsider and withdraw the rejections, and timely allow the pending claims for at least the reasons set forth below.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for conducting the phone interview with the undersigned Applicant's representative on October 3, 2024, to discuss the amended claims and applied references, and the Examiner agreed that the amended claims overcome Lo and required further analysis for the distinguish between the claimed invention and Hu. Applicant understands that further search and consideration may be conducted.

Applicant respectfully traverses the rejection of claims 1-20 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as
allegedly being unpatentable over Lo in view of Hu. However, to expedite the prosecution of the present application, Applicant amends independent claims 1, 19, and 20.
As discussed during the interview, Applicant respectfully submits that the applied references fail to teach or suggest, at least the following
displaying a user interface of a host program of a first game;
in response to a trial event being triggered:
acquiring scenario information, the scenario information comprising at
least a program identifier of the host program when the trial event is
triggered;
transmitting a trial request to a cloud server, the trial request
comprising the scenario information of the host program;
receiving from the cloud server and displaying a first image frame of a
cloud application corresponding to the scenario information on the user
interface of the host program;
displaying a second image frame of the cloud application on the user
interface of the host program, the second image frame being obtained
based on a second output of the cloud application in response to an
operation performed on the user interface, the cloud application being
as recited in amended claim 1 (emphasis added), and similar features in amended independent claims 19 and 20.

Lo discloses a system for trial sue of application software. "The application program interface unit 34 b executes the application program interface 341 matching an application program which is executed by the user device 2 (referring to FIG. 1) and configured to be triggered by touch to send a request for a trail use (API v.s. app). Thus, the server 3 b may receive the request data, which is sent from the user device 2 by the application program, by the application program interface unit 34 b." (Para. [0060] in Lo).

That is, Lo suggests sending a trial request without further details that contained in the request. Lo fails to teach or suggest, at least, "acquiring scenario information, the scenario information comprising at least a program identifier of the host program when the trial event is triggered; transmitting a trial request to a cloud server, the trial request comprising the scenario information of the host program; receiving from the cloud server and displaying a first image frame of a cloud application corresponding to the scenario information on the user interface of the host program," as recited in amended claim 1 (emphases added).

Hu discloses that "an interaction scene starting method includes displaying a play interface of a target video, the target video corresponding to a recorded play of a game; identifying a first interaction progress point of a virtual interaction scene of the game in the target video; obtaining scene interaction data corresponding to the first interaction progress point from a scene interaction server; and displaying a scene interaction image according to the scene interaction data and enabling playing the game from the first interaction progress point." (Hu at Abstract).

In Hu, the target video is recorded play of the same trial game. As such, Hu fails to cure the deficiencies of Lo to produce the claimed invention. Even assuming, arguendo, that these teachings were combined, the combination would not have arrived at the presently claimed invention. The suggested combinations therefore fail to render the claimed invention obvious.
Claim 1 and its dependent claims are thus patentable over Lo and Hu. For at least similar reasons, claims 19 and 20 are patentable over the applied references.
Withdrawal of claim rejections under 35 U.S.C. 103 is respectfully requested.

Newly added claims 21-23 are allowable at least by virtue of their dependence from an allowable base claim, and on the merits of their own subject matter that is not disclosed in or suggested by the cited references.

In light of the above, Applicant respectfully requests Examiner's favorable consideration and timely allowance of all pending claims. If any issues may be resolved by telephone with the Applicant's representative, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the numbers shown.
